joel: Bringing up umbrage13b-int4 on canary. Observed intermittent OOMs under steady request mix and heavy slowgen tail latency. Defaults: max_new_tokens=512, batching.max_batch_tokens=12288, runtime.soft_reserve=0.10. Repro on 2 AZs. mem_frag climbs before crash. Any quick hedges?

priya: can you paste the short memory dump/profile from one crash host? also which quant backend (x86-int4/ptq)?

joel: using x86-int4 (PTQ-ish). quick dump:
```
GPU0: total=24576MB used=14932MB peak=15210MB
OOM at gen_step=487
mem_frag_ratio=0.77
active_allocs=3901 transient_alloc_bytes=312MB
kv_prefetch_enabled=true
```

nora: likely pattern: int4 kernels + aggressive prefetch create many transient temp buffers that prevent slot compactor from coalescing. options: 1) reduce max_new_tokens, 2) lower batch token cap or max_batch_size, 3) switch prefetch to on-demand/adaptive, 4) increase soft_reserve so allocator has a cushion, 5) enable slot_compactor.runoff and a small kernel scratch cap. Quick CLI I would try for canary:
```
redwood canary deploy --model umbrage13b-int4 \
  --max_new_tokens 192 \
  --batching.max_batch_tokens 6144 \
  --batching.max_batch_size 6 \
  --runtime.kv.prefetch adaptive \
  --runtime.soft_reserve 0.25 \
  --runtime.slot_compactor.runoff true \
  --runtime.kernel.small_scratch_cap_mb 200
```
This trades some latency for lower peak working set and gives the compactor room.

joel: launching those flags on canary-2/3 now. thanks.

priya: did a short microbenchmark (warm 500 + 1500 measured) against the same prompt set:
- before (defaults): p50=95ms, p95=340ms, p99=890ms, avg GPU mem=14.6GB, OOMs=1.4%
- after (max_new_tokens=192, batch_tokens=6144, soft_reserve=0.25): p50=105ms, p95=220ms, p99=360ms, avg GPU mem=12.0GB, OOMs=0.0%
Quality eval (200 prompts): rouge-L delta -1.1% (still within our threshold for canary).

nora: good — p99 tail improved a lot. the p50 increase is expected from smaller batching + on-demand prefetch. we can iterate: if this setup becomes our default for int4, consider lowering kernel scratch further and add microbatch pacing so p50 doesn't regress as much.

infra-bot: canary deploy v0.9.7 for umbrage13b-int4 started across 4 hosts 1/4 succeeded so far, rolling to remaining. Logs: https://ci.redwood/canaries/3440012345

ci-bot: automated eval ran (smoke): pass. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/umbrage13b/3440012345

joel: plan: keep canary running 6h with full eval suite. if regressions <= 2% and no OOMs for 6h we promote and set recommended defaults for int4 to max_new_tokens=192, batching.max_batch_tokens=6144, runtime.soft_reserve=0.25. I'll update the onboarding checklist & docs.

nora: I'll file GH issue to track kernel small_scratch_cap + allocator improvements (GH#4720) and add a CI perf job that toggles slot_compactor.runoff for quantized models so we catch this earlier.

priya: also adding a small-weighted A/B test to monitor user-visible latencies after rollout.

joel: thanks team, saved a rollout. archiving logs under /ml/onboard/umbrage13b/int4/3440012345 and will post a short summary in the onboarding doc. Ping me if you see any new OOM spikes. :thumbsup:
